October 31, 2020
TCEVHA ADVISORY ON TYPHOON “ROLLY”
In preparation to the possible effect of Typhoon “Rolly” to our village, to all of us and to our properties, the TCEVHA management called an emergency meeting this morning with our maintenance crew and therein we set-up the following team:
• Flood Pump Operation  – The team will ensure our pumps operation to mitigate flooding to the usual most affected area, such as Mahogany Ave., Cypress and Kaimito Avenue.

• Parking and Traffic Control – Our security guards were given instruction to ensure unobstructed flow of traffic from the gate (ingress and egress), especially at Narra Avenue.  Note: Anyone who will leave his/her car on this area should leave a contact numbers to the gate guards. 

• Road Clearing Team  – With their limited capability to trim high trees, the team will trim down branches of trees that may fall down during the onslaught of typhoon.

•  Command / Evacuation Center – The Clubhouse Office and the Board Room shall be used as Command Center while the Multi Purpose Hall is reserved as Evacuation Center.
